row.team_price_text: Teams: $399/user, billed annually (2-20 users; page labels it "/month per user")
row.evidence: Pluralsight's SSO overview says Skills supports SAML 2.0 SSO and "Streamline user management with just-in-time (JIT) provisioning"; no SCIM endpoint is documented on the pricing page, help centre, developer portal schema, Okta or Entra pages.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none. June's 'SSO + SCIM provisioning standard on Enterprise' has no first-party source: the help centre (311 articles, searched for SCIM and provisioning), the developer-portal API schema and the Okta (SAML/SWA) and Entra (SSO with JIT) catalogue pages describe SAML SSO with just-in-time provisioning only. Pricing changed: the business page now shows two plans, Teams (2-20 users, $399 per user billed annually; the card reads "/month per user", which looks like a label error since June recorded $399/u/yr) and Enterprise (20+, Contact sales); June's Starter/Professional/Enterprise $399/$579/$779 tiers are gone. Per-user price left null because of the ambiguous label. SSO is listed as an optional Enterprise professional-services add-on on the pricing page, while the help centre says SSO is included at no additional cost on team plans (conflict recorded). Automation without SCIM: GraphQL API (invite, edit, remove users and licences, teams, roles) on all business plans, CSV import, and Workday/HRIS team-sync and licence provisioning connectors.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Price label reads '/month per user, billed annually'; likely $399 per user per year. Help centre says SSO is included at no extra cost on team plans.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO listed under optional add-on professional services.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented on any page searched; recorded as none by absence. June's Enterprise SCIM claim could not be sourced.

endpoints.purpose: List users who have used a licence on the plan
Invite a user to the plan
Remove users from the plan (managers/admins keep plan access, lose licence)
Add a licensed user to a team
Assign users to a Role IQ role

limitations.text: Operation-level plan gates in the schema: user and team operations are tagged for STARTER, PRO and ENT hubs; role operations for PRO and ENT only (read from the schema's subscription directives).

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML and SWA only; no SCIM or provisioning boxes. Last updated Feb 18, 2016.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SP-initiated SAML SSO with JIT user creation; no provisioning tutorial (pluralsight-provisioning-tutorial 404).

google.notes: Google named as a supported SAML IdP; no Marketplace or catalogue listing checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Workday/HRIS team-structure sync and licence provisioning/deprovisioning connectors (Developer Portal Integrations Hub)
